personal_info.headline: Staff Software Engineer | AI/ML & Distributed Systems Architect

summary: With over 6 years of enterprise experience designing fault-tolerant microservices, high-throughput machine learning ranking systems, and zero-trust AI architectures. Proven track record bridging classic backend distributed systems (Java/Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, low-latency microservices) with modern predictive ML (XGBoost Learning-to-Rank, Feature Stores, MLOps) and Gen AI (Agentic FSM Runtimes, GraphRAG via MCP). Expert in sub-50ms p99 serving latency, position debiasing, online-offline feature skew detection, and end-to-end ML lifecycle ownership.

highlights: Machine Learning & Ranking Systems: Learning-to-Rank (LTR), XGBoost, Two-Stage Candidate Retrieval (H3 Geospatial Indexing, Inverted Index), Feature Stores (Redis/Feast), Position Debiasing (Inverse Propensity Scoring), Multi-Objective Optimization, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch.
